codeReview.summary: The main.m refactor is excellent. Reduced from 23 lines to 10 lines of code (19 total lines including imports/comments). The new implementation imports ISHInstrumentation.h and calls [ISHInstrumentation bootstrap] before UIApplicationMain, with the exception handler preserved.
